purpose: Candidate target profile for bounded GitHub-hosted engineering jobs; not an authorization to dispatch agents, access provider credentials, or make provider calls.

runner_profile.target_plan_assumption: GitHub Free; account subscription itself was not independently verified
runner_profile.standard_runner_cost_for_public_repo: free; public repository standard runners are documented as free and unlimited
runner_profile.operational_guardrail: Use <=330 minutes as a proposed work deadline to preserve time for evidence publication and teardown; not a GitHub platform limit.

isolation.vm_lifecycle: each non-slim standard hosted job receives a fresh VM; VM is ephemeral
isolation.workspace: GITHUB_WORKSPACE is job-local and may be shared by steps in the same job; never treat it as cross-job shared storage
isolation.cross_job_exchange: explicitly published artifacts or source-control commits only; no implicit shared filesystem
isolation.checkout: persist-credentials=false; checkout only immutable target SHA
isolation.token_permissions: permissions: contents: read by default; add no write permissions in this target profile
isolation.secret_handling: no provider secrets in source, task envelope, prompts, artifacts, caches or logs; no secret reads in this qualification pass
isolation.cleanup: VM disposal after job; explicit artifact retention and deletion policy still requires qualification

network.egress_model: direct outbound HTTPS from hosted runner
network.source_ip: dynamic/shared by default; no stable source IP assumed
network.fixed_ip_exception: If a provider requires IP allowlisting, this profile is incompatible until a separately approved static-egress target is selected.
network.destination_allowlist_enforcement: NOT VERIFIED for standard hosted runner network layer; provider calls remain blocked until enforceable policy and per-task destination authorization are accepted.
network.inter_runner_network: no guaranteed direct reachability, bandwidth, latency, packet-loss SLA or shared private network; do not assume a cluster fabric
network.distributed_model_parallelism: not qualified; do not use this profile for tensor/pipeline parallel inference
network.benchmark: read-only, non-secret tests to approved GitHub endpoints only; measure DNS/TLS/connect latency, upload/download throughput, packet loss where supported, job stability and teardown. Provider endpoints require separate authorization.

acceptance_gates: destination-level egress enforcement and data policy accepted
exact workflow SHA and runner target independently reviewed
schema Draft 2020-12 validation and negative fixtures accepted
task identity, capability, quota, expiry and revocation gates accepted

known_unknowns: Actual account plan was not exposed by repository metadata; Free plan is an assumption for concurrency planning.
Actual account-level concurrent job capacity and queue behavior have not been measured.
Standard hosted runner network throughput, RTT, packet loss and inter-runner reachability have not been benchmarked.
Artifact retention/deletion settings and effective organization/repository policies were not inspected.
Enforceable outbound destination allowlisting for standard runners is not demonstrated.
